description: Hide or show the BrewPage badge on a publication. Needs an owner token that is in a BrewPage profile (free sign-in at https://account.brewpage.app); up to 5 hidden per profile.

hidden.description: true = hide the badge, false = show it. Omit: report the current state.

ownerToken.description: Owner token from create. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

name: set_badge
title: Hide or show badge
